title.narrative: Scaling-up of high impact interventions in the fight against TB - Burkina Faso (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Burkina Faso, Tuberculosis, Programme d'Appui au Développement Sanitaire (PADS) (PADS)This program has the following goals: Contribuer à l’amélioration de l’état de santé de la population du Burkina Faso en réduisant le poids de la tuberculose d’ici à fin 2026./ To contribute to the improvement of the health status of the population of Burkina Faso by reducing the burden of tuberculosis by the end of 2026.. The objectives of this program are: Réduire l’incidence de la tuberculose de 45 en 2021 à 36 cas/100 000 habitants en 2026 / Reduce the incidence of tuberculosis from 45 in 2021 to 36 cases/100,000 inhabitants in 2026. Reduire le taux de mortalité de la tuberculose de 6,4 en 2021 à 5,5 décès/100 000 habitants d’ici à fin 2026 / Reduce the mortality rate of tuberculosis from 6.4 in 2021 to 5.5 deaths/100,000 inhabitants by the end of 2026. Accroître le taux de succès au traitement des patients TB pharmaco sensibles de 81,5% (cohorte 2020) à au moins 90% (cohorte 2025) et ceux TB-résistante de 75% (cohorte 2020) à au moins 80% (cohorte 2025) / Increase the treatment success rate of drug-susceptible TB patients from 81.5% (2020 cohort) to at least 90% (2025 cohort) and drug-resistant TB from 75% (2020 cohort) to at least 80% (2025 cohort)

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for BFA-T-PADSP04
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment

Percentage of notified patients with all forms of TB (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed) contributed by non-national TB program providers- community referrals; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Number of people with TB (all forms) notified among prisoners; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with TB (all forms) notified among key affected populations/high risk groups (other than prisoners); *includes only those with new and relapse
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
